newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: SFE wheat steady to tending down in watchful mood.
newsitem.headline: SFE wheat steady to tending down in watchful mood.

text.p: Sydney Futures Exchange (SFE) wheat futures were steady to slightly down on Friday in reaction to the day's recovery in the Australian dollar and to Chicago wheat's overnight fall.
January 1998 sold at A$193.50 a tonne, down by 50 cents.
Eleven January contracts provided the only sales.
Settlement prices were steady virtually across the board.
Chicago wheat's fall caused SFE to drift down a little, Gary Booth of Ord Minnett Jardine Fleming Futures said.
"The market is really taking a wait and see look to the weather situation," he said.
